issue_context.title: Let `PointGet` be a choice of `DataSource`'s PhysicalPlan.
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

There're two api to access data in TiKV. One is kv's Get/BatchGet, the other is coprocessor. Get/BatchGet is lighter than coprocessor. There's no other calculation(like filter or aggregate). The Get will have significant stronger performance compared with coprocessor.

So there is a need to make the `PointGet` as a choice of `DataSource`'s Physical Plan.
comments:
> The Get will have significant stronger performance compared with coprocessor.

Do we have some benchmark result to quantify the performance difference?

review_comments: This branch could never be hit?
fixed after make single range partition table to convert to point get
If we would always prefer PointGet, we can simply return here?

No, we can't, consider this query:

```sql
select * from t where t.a = 1 and t.b in (1, 2, 3);
```

If there is a unique index for t.a and a unique index for t.b. Then we should compare the cost for these two point-get plans.

Just wondering, how does `PointGet` work when the columns needed are not in the unique index?

```
mysql> create table tbl(a int, b int, unique key(b));
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)

mysql> explain select * from tbl where b = 1;
+-------------+---------+------+--------------------+
| id          | estRows | task | operator info      |
+-------------+---------+------+--------------------+
| Point_Get_1 | 1.00    | root | table:tbl, index:b |
+-------------+---------+------+--------------------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)

mysql> explain select a from tbl where b = 1;
+-------------+---------+------+--------------------+
| id          | estRows | task | operator info      |
+-------------+---------+------+--------------------+
| Point_Get_1 | 1.00    | root | table:tbl, index:b |
+-------------+---------+------+--------------------+
```
Point get can't work in the none-unique index. Because the key of the none-unique index is `${index_value}_${handle}`, we can't construct the keys to call the RPC "KVGet".
In point-get executor, it realized double read logic.
PointGet can do double read itself.
Check if the returned task is `invalidTask`?
The cost of `invalidTask` is always the max float64. Never be choosen.
Can we simply return a constant here?
Why? You mean when we can get the point-get plan, other plans should not be considered?
It means whether there is a point-get plan for the query.
